name: Priapos
fa_note: A Grande Grotta classic: jugs and tufa horns all the way, and a pump that builds with every metre. The game records no first ascensionist.

name: DNA
fa_note: Tufas twisting up the steep heart of the Grotta, sustained to the anchor. The game records no first ascensionist.

name: Aegialis
fa_note: Small pockets and crimps between the tufas, for twenty-nine metres. The game records no first ascensionist.
